import Mathlib
open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Limits MonoidalCategory
open CartesianMonoidalCategory MonObj

-- Mathlib ONLY. Is a group scheme over a field separated, by any route?
example {K : Type u} [Field K] (G : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) [GrpObj G] :
    IsSeparated G.hom := by
  infer_instance

-- control: the unit section IS a closed immersion by synthesis
example {K : Type u} [Field K] (G : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) [GrpObj G] :
    IsClosedImmersion (Over.Hom.left (MonObj.one (M := G))) := by
  infer_instance
